==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|orv|судити}}, from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*sǭdìti}}. See also {{m|ru|суд}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|суди́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-судить.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|суди́ть|impf}}

# to [[judge]], to [[try]], to [[adjudicate]]
# to [[judge]] {{gl|to form an opinion on}}
#: {{ux|ru|Я стара́юсь беспристра́стно '''суди́ть''' о лю́дях.|I'm trying to '''judge''' people impartially.}}
#: {{uxi|ru|'''су́дя''' по всему́|to all appearances}}
# {{lb|ru|poetic|or|dated}} to [[destine]], to [[predetermine]]
